name: Regret
description: What a pile of cash would be worth today if you had bought gold, bitcoin, oil, Nifty, Reliance, or the S&P on that date. Cash left alone is in the list too.

params.name: date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD. A weekend walks forward to the next session.

params.name: amount
params.description: How much cash you pretend you had.

params.name: currency
params.description: INR or USD. Defaults to INR.

params.name: only
params.description: Comma list if you do not want the whole basket. gold, btc, oil, nifty, reliance, sp500.

response.verdict: Bitcoin did 16.61x. The rupees under the mattress are still 100000.

errors.message: could not load the rupee rate

name: Portfolio
description: POST a list of holdings and get them marked to today's spot in INR or USD. Aliases cover gold, silver, platinum, copper, oil, gas, btc, eth, and the usual indices. Anything else is a stock ticker. GET /api/v1/portfolio lists the aliases. Gold/silver/platinum amounts are troy ounces; copper is pounds.

params.name: currency
params.description: INR or USD for the total and for cash. Defaults to INR. Sent in the JSON body.

params.name: holdings
params.description: JSON array of { id, amount }. 1 to 20 rows. Duplicate ids merge.

response.verdict: Gold is 44% of the pile. Cash is the quiet leftover.

errors.message: none of those holdings had a price

name: Split
description: POST a bill total and a list of people with shares. Each person gets what they owe in the request currency plus INR and USD via today's rupee rate. share is a fraction or the string equal. GET /api/v1/split shows the body shape.

params.name: total
params.description: Bill total in the request currency. Sent in the JSON body.

params.name: currency
params.description: INR or USD. Defaults to INR.

params.name: people
params.description: JSON array of { name, share }. 1 to 20. share is 0-1 or equal.

errors.message: could not load the rupee rate

name: Ladder
description: POST a date, amount, and weighted buys. Same growth math as regret, but you pick the mix. Weights must add to 1. Cash left alone is always in the result. GET /api/v1/ladder lists the assets.

params.name: date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the JSON body. A weekend walks forward.

params.name: amount
params.description: Cash you pretend you had.

params.name: currency
params.description: INR or USD. Defaults to INR.

params.name: buys
params.description: JSON array of { id, weight }. 1 to 6. Weights sum to 1. ids: gold, btc, oil, nifty, reliance, sp500.

response.verdict: Bitcoin did 16.61x. The rupees under the mattress are still 100000.

name: Invoice
description: POST a messy bill of aliases, tickers, and cash lines. Marks assets to today's spot, totals in INR or USD, and says what most of the invoice is. GET /api/v1/invoice lists the aliases.

params.name: currency
params.description: INR or USD for the total. Defaults to INR. Sent in the JSON body.

params.name: lines

name: URL Shortener
description: POST a long http(s) url to get a short code stored in Cloudflare KV. Optional custom code and ttlDays. GET /api/v1/short/:code returns JSON. GET /api/v1/short/:code/go redirects. Same url twice returns the existing code.

params.name: url
params.description: http or https url in the JSON body.

params.name: code
params.description: Optional custom slug, 3-32 chars. Letters, numbers, _ or -.

params.name: ttlDays
params.description: Optional expiry in days, 1 to 365.

errors.message: url has to be http or https

name: QR Generator
description: Stick text or a URL in, get a QR code back as SVG or PNG. Optional size, ecc, margin, and colors. Default is image/svg+xml; format=png returns image/png; format=json wraps the svg and a data URI. Nothing stored.

params.name: text
params.description: String to encode. Trimmed. Max 1024 characters.

params.name: size
params.description: Output width and height in px, 64 to 1024. Default 256.

params.name: ecc
params.description: Error correction: L, M, Q, or H. Default M.

params.name: format
params.description: svg (default), png, or json.

errors.message: size has to be an integer from 64 to 1024
ecc has to be L, M, Q, or H
